item.title: IW planners postpone vote on battery storage ordinance
item.description: Isle of Wight County's Planning Commission delayed its vote on proposed battery storage rules following a Feb. 24 public hearing.

item.title: Editorial – Disappointing day for Carrollton
item.description: Isle of Wight supervisors approved two contested Carrollton housing projects last week, defying broad citizen opposition over traffic and school impacts.

item.title: IW-backed 1% sales tax for new schools bill passes House
item.description: An Isle of Wight-backed bill to let any Virginia locality hold a voter referendum on a 1% sales tax for school construction passed the House of Delegates while similar Senate measures stalled.

item.title: Letter – Can’t take rights for granted
item.description: Letter: Smithfield resident Deborah Wyld agrees with John Edwards' column last week that Americans’ constitutional rights — from free speech to privacy and gun ownership — are being eroded.

item.title: Surry School Board adopts $20.2 million 2026-27 budget
item.description: Surry's School Board approved a $20.2 million 2026-27 budget with funding for employee raises and two new Surry Elementary teachers.

item.title: Bills to allow ranked-choice voting in towns pass their originating chambers
item.description: Virginia bills allowing ranked-choice voting for towns like Smithfield have cleared their first hurdles, potentially changing how crowded local races decide winners.
